title: Label and limit per card brand next to an existing fee switch
task: We also need a display label per card brand (`Visa`, `Mastercard`, `American Express`) and a maximum transaction in cents per brand (500000 for Visa and Mastercard, 1000000 for Amex), as `Label(brand Brand) (string, error)` and `MaxTransaction(brand Brand) (int, error)` alongside the existing fee. Adding a brand later should mean touching one place.
